KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.

2. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. mitoto
   B. watoto
   C. mato
   D. kitoto

3. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.

4. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.

5. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. fupi
   B. nene
   C. zito
   D. pana

6. When practising Anga, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Anga.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Anga.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Anga.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Anga.

7. When practising Huyo na Hao, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Huyo na Hao.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Huyo na Hao.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Huyo na Hao.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Huyo na Hao.

8. When practising herufi kubwa, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding herufi kubwa.
   B. Use insults to “practise” herufi kubwa.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for herufi kubwa.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to herufi kubwa.

9. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   B. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   C. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   D. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain Anga and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Msamiati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain uliopita and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
